component.name: Authenticator
component.summary: Two-factor codes, on Proton Authenticator's open-source core

description.p: A native COSMIC app for two-factor (TOTP and Steam) codes. Codes, imports, exports and encryption come from Proton Authenticator's open-source Rust core. Not an official Proton app, and not synced with a Proton account.

ul.li: Add codes from a setup key, a QR code image or an otpauth:// link
Import from Proton Authenticator, Proton Pass, Aegis, 2FAS, Bitwarden, Ente, LastPass and Google Authenticator
Export as a Proton Authenticator file, with or without a password
Codes are encrypted on disk, with the key in the system keyring
